messages:
incident-bot: Pager: cache_consistency.alert severity=sev2 — increased error-rate on model-serving reads attributed to stale KV lookups. Affected region: eu-west-1. root cause suspected: prefetch surge + eviction churn.

alice_oncall: I'm on it, grabbing context and will page SRE + ML.

bob_sre: on call. quick summary from infra metrics: prefetched keys spiked x7 in last 2m; eviction rate up, cache fill failed for ~30s windows. Some requests hit older versions because prefix fencing not enforced during prefetch fallback.

carol_ml: seeing end-to-end failures for a small set of tenants (10-15) — higher latency and hallucinations reported by downstream eval checks. Likely correctness issue, not just perf.

dave_support: flagged two paying customers (ACME Corp, FinNova) — support alerted them with "we're investigating". They reported 5% of requests returning inconsistent outputs.

eva_eng: suggested mitigations: 1) temporary disable prefetch for affected cohort 2) route critical customers to dedicated routing pool 3) enable cache_fence mode to force KV reads to bypass stale cache on read-miss.

bob_sre: agreed. Plan in order: (A) disable prefetch globally for eu-west-1 traffic-patterns matching the spike, (B) enable cache_fence to force fresh KV reads for requests that require correctness, (C) apply a soft rate-cap to bursty tenants to reduce eviction churn.

alice_oncall: I'll do the disable prefetch step. Doing ramped command now: `infra-cli feature-toggle prefetch --region eu-west-1 --state off --ramp 30s`  — posting deploy bot output in thread. :eyes:

incident-bot: deploy: feature-toggle prefetch off queued by alice_oncall — waiting for approval.

frank_ops: approval given. executing.

incident-bot: deploy: feature-toggle prefetch off completed (started 14:32:10 UTC, completed 14:32:40 UTC).

bob_sre: observing tail metrics — prefetch traffic dropped ~85% in 60s. eviction rate falling.

carol_ml: triggering on-demand evals against sample prompts for affected tenants. Early signs: inconsistency rate down from 5% to ~0.7%. Good.

eva_eng: next step: enable cache_fence for served prefixes where correctness SLO is required. This will bypass cached prefix KV on read if fence_version != current_version. Command: `infra-cli config set cache_fence=true --prefix-match 'tenant:critical:*' --region eu-west-1`

bob_sre: rolling the cache_fence flag to 5% of traffic first. `infra-cli config rollout cache_fence --pct 5 --region eu-west-1`

incident-bot: rollout initiated by bob_sre — 5% traffic.

alice_oncall: also applying soft rate-limit carveout to noisy tenants: `ratectl set tenant ACME max_rps 30 --burst 60` and similar for FinNova.

dave_support: emailing status to ACME and FinNova: "We've disabled prefetch and enabled integrity fence for requests that require correctness; you may see slightly higher latency but correctness has improved. We're monitoring."

bob_sre: after 10m of 5% rollout, bumping to 50% for cache_fence. Monitoring key miss/error SLOs.

incident-bot: rollout 50% completed.

carol_ml: evaluations on 50% cohort show correctness anomalies down to 0.2%. Latency p50 increased ~40ms on fenced reads — within acceptable SLO for these tenants.

eva_eng: recommend keeping cache_fence for critical prefixes and working on longer-term fix in model-serving prefetch logic (prefetch backpressure + eviction-aware admission). I'll open a design ticket.

bob_sre: mitigation summary: prefetch disabled regionally, cache_fence enabled for critical prefixes (rolled to 50%), soft per-tenant rate-caps applied for noisy tenants, support notified. No rollback required.

alice_oncall: oncall handoff to bob_sre for overnight watch. Leaving notes in pager duty.

frank_ops: adding temporary dashboard and alert thresholds to watch eviction_rate, prefetched_keys/sec, and fenced_read_latency.

dave_support: customers acknowledged, ACME reduced error reports to near-zero, FinNova on standby.

alice_oncall: closing paging loop — will update postmortem template and link to the incident ticket (#INC-2026-432). Thanks all. :thumbsup:

frank_ops: quick follow-up: short-term customer action item — offer FinNova an option to be routed to dedicated capacity until prefetch fix lands. Dave, can you coordinate?

dave_support: will do, pinging account execs now.

incident-bot: Incident closed: cache_consistency.alert — mitigations applied, monitored for 1h without regression.

alice_oncall: postmortem TODOs: 1) root cause analysis (prefetch admission + eviction interaction) 2) add automatic prefetch backpressure rule 3) improve observability for prefix-version drift 4) customer comms follow-through. I'll assign owners in the ticket.

carol_ml: noted, I'll own the prefetch backpressure design.

eva_eng: I'll pair with infra to implement cache_fence rollout automation and tests.

bob_sre: adding incident timeline and metric graphs to the ticket.

dave_support: closing customer loop after dedicated routing decision.

frank_ops: thanks team.
